title: Multiplayer Breakout 3D
prompt:
Create a complete HTML file implementing a 3D multiplayer breakout game using Three.js. Two paddles, two balls, and a shared brick field in the center.

## Scene Setup
- Use a perspective camera at position (0, 25, 30) looking at origin.
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.5) and a directional light at (10, 20, 10) with intensity 0.8.
- The playing field is a flat 3D arena: X range [-15, 15], Z range [-20, 20]. Add a dark gray ground plane (BoxGeometry 30x0.2x40) at Y=0.
- Add translucent blue walls on the left (X=-15) and right (X=15) sides, height 2, spanning the full Z range.

## Load 3D Asset
- Load 'CesiumMilkTruck.glb' using GLTFLoader. Scale it to (0.5, 0.5, 0.5). Place it as a decorative trophy object at position (0, 3, 0) above the brick field. Rotate it slowly around Y axis (0.5 rad/s). Store reference in window.__3D_STATE__.truckModel. This trophy spins faster when bricks are destroyed (add 0.1 rad/s per brick destroyed, capped at 3.0 rad/s).

## Paddles
- Player 1 paddle: Blue box (3x0.5x0.8) at Z = -18 (bottom). Moves left/right with 'A' and 'D' keys. Clamped to X range [-13.5, 13.5].
- Player 2 paddle: Red box (3x0.5x0.8) at Z = 18 (top). Moves left/right with ArrowLeft and ArrowRight keys. Clamped to X range [-13.5, 13.5].
- Paddle speed: 0.4 units per frame.

## Balls
- Ball 1 (white sphere, radius 0.3): Starts at (0, 0.5, -16), initial velocity (0.12, 0, 0.15).
- Ball 2 (yellow sphere, radius 0.3): Starts at (0, 0.5, 16), initial velocity (-0.12, 0, -0.15).
- Balls bounce off side walls (reflect X velocity), bounce off paddles (reflect Z velocity, add slight X offset based on hit position on paddle).
- If a ball passes beyond Z=-20 or Z=20, the opposing player scores a point and the ball resets to center with default velocity toward the player who lost the ball.
- Ball Y stays at 0.5 (2D motion on the XZ plane at fixed height).

## Bricks
- Create a 6-column x 4-row grid of bricks centered at origin. Each brick is a box (1.8x0.5x0.8) with 0.2 gap between them.
- Row colors from front: green, yellow, orange, red. Each brick takes 1 hit to destroy.
- Total bricks: 24. When a ball hits a brick, remove it, increment the destroying player's score by 10, and play a visual flash (briefly make ground emissive white for 100ms).

## Scoring & HUD
- Create a DOM overlay HUD showing: 'P1 Score: X' (bottom-left, blue text), 'P2 Score: X' (top-right, red text), 'Bricks Left: N' (top-center, white text).
- Add a 'Start Game' button (id='startBtn') centered on screen. Game is paused until clicked. Button hides when clicked.
- Add a 'Reset' button (id='resetBtn') at bottom-center, always visible. Clicking resets all state to initial.

## Game State (window.__3D_STATE__)
Expose the following on window.__3D_STATE__:
- gameStarted: boolean (false initially, true after Start clicked)
- p1Score: number (Player 1 score)
- p2Score: number (Player 2 score)
- bricksRemaining: number (starts at 24)
- ball1Velocity: {x, z} current velocity of ball 1
- ball2Velocity: {x, z} current velocity of ball 2
- ball1Position: {x, z} current position of ball 1
- ball2Position: {x, z} current position of ball 2
- p1PaddleX: number (Player 1 paddle X position)
- p2PaddleX: number (Player 2 paddle X position)
- truckRotationSpeed: number (current truck rotation speed in rad/s)
- bricksDestroyed: number (total bricks destroyed)
- gameOver: boolean (true when bricksRemaining === 0)
- winner: string ('P1'|'P2'|'TIE'|null) set when game is over based on higher score
- truckModelLoaded: boolean (true when GLTF model loaded)

## Physics Rules
- Ball speed magnitude should remain roughly constant (normalize velocity after paddle bounce to maintain speed ~0.19 units/frame).
- Balls must not go through walls or paddles.
- No NaN values in any position or velocity.

## Game Over
- When all 24 bricks are destroyed, set gameOver=true, determine winner by score, display 'GAME OVER - [Winner] WINS!' overlay text (id='gameOverText').
physics_constraints: Ball velocity magnitude ~0.19 units/frame after normalization. Balls reflect off walls (X) and paddles (Z). Paddles clamped to [-13.5, 13.5]. Balls reset when passing Z boundaries. No NaN in positions/velocities. Brick collisions remove bricks and award 10 points.
